endorsements.name: David Bianco
endorsements.label: Go to Hunt Then Sleep
endorsements.description: Are nightmares of data breaches and targeted attacks keeping your CISO up at night? You know you should be hunting for these threats, but where do you start? Told in the style of the popular children's story spoof, this soothing bedtime tale will lead Li'l Threat Hunters through the first five hunts they should do to find bad guys and, ultimately, help their CISOs "Go the F*#k to Sleep."
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2017

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
